answer: One defense is quadratic-staked identity. To join, an agent locks tokens in a bond; influence grows with the square root of that bond, so splitting capital across a thousand fake wallets buys less power than one honest identity. A random audit broadcasts a challenge each node must echo through a neighbour; the resulting trellis of attestations carries an honest signal a clone cannot forge without controlling every link. The attacker pays the quadratic stake penalty plus the full upkeep of all fake identities and connections.
